preconditions.description: The size of the broom is an integer between 2 and 300,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: Each ui and vi are integers between 1 and n inclusive.
preconditions.description: The vertices are numbered from 1 to n, and the edges connect these vertices.

preconditions.expression: Each xi is a lowercase Latin letter.
preconditions.description: The edges are marked with lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.expression: The output should contain two lines.
postconditions.description: The first line contains the minimum possible size of the broom after its simplification.

postconditions.expression: The second line contains the integer p.
postconditions.description: If there are several suitable p values, the smallest one should be printed.

invariants.expression: The broom is a rooted tree with edges marked with letters.
invariants.description: The broom is constructed as described, and it is a valid rooted tree.

invariants.expression: The simplification process erases the p-th letter from all words of length at least p.
invariants.description: The simplification process is performed according to the rules given.

invariants.expression: The goal is to minimize the size of the broom after simplification.
invariants.description: The objective is to find the smallest possible size of the broom after simplification and the smallest p that achieves this.
